name: agent-farm
description: A Blender-rendered 2.5D farm where every AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode, Ollama ...) is a farm animal showing its live status.

scripts.build:mac: ARCH=arm64 bash macos/build.sh && ARCH=x64 bash macos/build.sh
scripts.build:win: node desktop/fetch-node.mjs win32 x64 && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux: node desktop/fetch-node.mjs linux ${ARCH:-x64} && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux --${ARCH:-x64} --publish never

author: irons163
